description: Hotfix 3.12.1 of the prod-gate (D-43): a prod approval is bound to the change the human's phrase names; an approval in the repo that owns a change covers the [Deploy] <id> PRs of the repos it declares; REST calls that complete a PR or approve a production pipeline, and commands run outside a repo, pass the same SHA-bound gate; a read-only listing of the state paths is not blocked (BL-64); widened by D-45: the session hook loads only the working repo's profile and withholds sensitive handoffs elsewhere, the prod-gate decides on the PR's own repo and base (non-Karvey targets warn), the production OK is always typed (never a question tool), a production-shaped phrase always gets one hook line, and the approve refusal names the markers it found.
goal: A production approval reaches exactly the change and the commits the human approved, whatever repo, working tree or command form the release goes through.
security_tier_reason: changes the approval hook and the prod-gate, the guards that stand between an agent and a production merge

revision_history.reason: owner widened the hotfix with defects found in use (D-45): profile injected from another agent's folder, prod-gate decided by the session's cwd repo, prod OK asked through a question tool, silent approval hook, opaque approve error; REST to non-Karvey repos warns; BUG-53/54 renumbered to BUG-138/139 (held by another branch)
